<tabber>Permanent Achievements=
{{Achievement|Death From Below|jpg|Kill {{color|value|25}} [[Enemies (Payday 2)|enemies]] as they rappel using the [[Nagant]] sniper rifle. Unlocks the [[Masks (Payday 2)#Gage Historical Pack DLC|Constable]] mask, the Silenced Barrel and the Long Barrel for the Nagant sniper rifle, “[[Materials#Gage Historical Pack DLC|Gunsmoke]]” material and “[[Patterns#Gage Historical Pack DLC|Dazzle]]” pattern.}}
{{Achievement|Special Operations Execution|jpg|Kill {{color|value|25}} [[Enemies (Payday 2)|enemies]] while in stealth using the [[Trench Knife|Trench knife]]. Unlocks the [[Masks (Payday 2)#Gage Historical Pack DLC|Red Bear]] mask, Short Barrel, Suppressed Barrel, Short Mag, Folded Stock, No Stock, Solid Stock, Heatsinked Suppressed Barrel for the [[Patchett L2A1]] submachine gun, Barrel Sight 44, Damper.L 44 Nozzle for the [[Broomstick]] pistol, “[[Materials#Gage Historical Pack DLC|Red Sun]]” material and “[[Patterns#Gage Historical Pack DLC|Death Dealer]]” pattern.}}
{{Achievement|Wind of Change|jpg|In the [[Hoxton Breakout]] job, complete the heist while you and your {{color|value|four}} man crew are wearing one different "[[Masks (Payday 2)#Gage Historical Pack DLC|Historical]]" mask each on OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the Discreet Stock and Short Barrel for the [[Nagant]] sniper rifle, Precision Barrel for the [[Broomstick]] pistol, Extended Mag and Long Barrel for the [[Patchett L2A1]] submachine gun and the Heatsinked Suppressed Barrel for the [[Buzzsaw 42]] light machine gun.}}
{{Achievement|So Uncivilized|jpg|Equip a [[Broomstick]] pistol with the Damper.L 44 Nozzle and the Barrel Sight 44. Unlocks the [[Masks (Payday 2)#Gage Historical Pack DLC|British Bulldog]] mask, High Capacity Mag and Holster Stock for the [[Broomstick]] pistol, "[[Materials#Gage Historical Pack DLC|Army Green]]" material and "[[Patterns#Gage Historical Pack DLC|Filthy Thirteen]]" pattern.}}
{{Achievement|Bullet Hell|jpg|Kill {{color|value|10}} [[Enemies (Payday 2)|enemies]] within {{color|value|10}} seconds using the [[Buzzsaw 42]] light machine gun. Unlocks the [[Masks (Payday 2)#Gage Historical Pack DLC|Old Blood and Guts]] mask, Light Barrel for the Buzzsaw 42 light machine gun, "[[Materials#Gage Historical Pack DLC|Patriot]]" material and "[[Patterns#Gage Historical Pack DLC|Captain War]]" pattern.}}

|-|Trivia=
* The '''Death from Below''' achievement is a play on the phrase "death from above", which refers to the ability of airborne soldiers to cause chaos behind enemy lines.
* '''Special Operations Executive''' is a reference to the British covert operations organisation of {{w|Special Operations Executive|the same name}} during World War II.
* The '''Winds of Change''' achievement is a reference to a {{w|Wind of Change (speech)|speech}} made by Prime Minister {{w|Harold MacMillan}} to the parliament of South Africa in 1960.
* '''So Uncivilized''' is a reference to a line by {{w|Obi-Wan Kenobi}} from ''{{w|Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith|Star Wars Episode III}}'' after killing General Grevious with a blaster. Unlocking this achievement requires modding the [[Broomstick]] to closely resemble Han Solo's DL-44 blaster pistol from the original ''{{w|Star Wars}}'' trilogy.
* '''Bullet Hell''' is a reference to a genre of 2D shoot-em-ups known as bullet-hell (also danmaku, curtain, or manic) shooters. What sets bullet-hell apart from other shoot-em-up games is the sheer number of projectiles (or bullets) which tend to be on the screen at once.
